$comment: Source of truth for the text-preview allowlist. Edit this file only. The Go side embeds this JSON directly; the TS side (packages/views/editor/utils/preview-allowlist.ts) is regenerated from this file by `pnpm generate:preview-allowlist`. packages/views/editor/utils/preview-allowlist.test.ts compares the generated TS with this file and runs in CI, so a stale regeneration fails the build.
